subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de adição e de subtração, envolvendo números de até dois algarismos, com os significados de juntar, acrescentar, separar e retirar, com o suporte de imagens e/ou material manipulável, utilizando estratégias e formas de registro pessoais.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de adição com até dois dígitos envolvendo significados de juntar ou acrescentar
components.description_en: Solve addition problems with up to two-digit numbers involving joining or adding-to meanings
components.cc_component_description: Use addition within 20 to solve word problems involving adding to and putting together an amount, with unknowns in all positions

components.description_pt: Compor problemas de adição e subtração com até dois dígitos usando imagens ou materiais manipuláveis
components.description_en: Compose addition and subtraction problems with up to two-digit numbers using images or manipulative materials
components.cc_component_description: Use physical objects or drawings to represent and solve addition and subtraction problems

components.description_pt: Registrar soluções de problemas de adição e subtração usando estratégias pessoais e notações
components.description_en: Record solutions to addition and subtraction problems using personal strategies and notation
components.cc_component_description: Use drawings or equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent addition and subtraction problems within 100

cc_matches.description: Use addition and subtraction within 20 to solve word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions, e.g., by using objects, drawings, and equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem.

Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve one- and two-step word problems involving situations of adding to, taking from, putting together, taking apart, and comparing, with unknowns in all positions, e.g., by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown number to represent the problem.
